issues.message: DEM has 14.74% missing cells (largest contiguous hole: 1369 cells); holes are treated as open drains.
Excluded 7.620 km2 of permanent water surface from the ponding analysis.

basin_qc.note: Deep tiny ponds and steep-catchment basins are reported separately: the first are candidate DEM artefacts, the second lie outside the validity domain of a depression-storage model.
